Coverage_Description: All-risks household contents protection with accidental damage; limits up to HK$1,500,000/year and HK$150,000/item, plus third-party legal liability up to HK$15,000,000/year; optional building structure and selected add-on covers
pricing: Basic cover annual premium HK$680-2,780 (area/plan-based); Home Appliance Warranty add-on HK$409-1,312/year; Building Structure premium rate 0.07% of sum insured with basic cover (0.09% if structure-only and owner-occupied).
customer requirement: Applicant must be 18+; residential premises only
price structure: Annual premium table by saleable/gross floor area and plan tier (Harmony/Premier); optional building structure priced by % of sum insured
additional informations: 3-day typhoon waiting period (Signal No.8 or above already hoisted); loyalty bonus +HK$50,000 household contents on each renewal (max +HK$200,000); excess: HK$250 basic cover, HK$3,000 optional cover
